what_this_is: What ARVE's own scanners see: the ARVE-pinned scanner versions run over ONLY the files ARVE's ingestion FileFilter keeps, with no .git directory. Compare against gitleaks-baseline.json / osv-baseline.json, which are the reference versions over the whole repository, to separate an ingestion gap from a scanner gap.
